name: LFM3-1.7B
context_scaling: native to 262144: rope_parameters gives two policies, full_attention with rope_type default and rope_theta 1000000 plus partial_rotary_factor 0.5, sliding_attention with rope_theta 10000; no rope_scaling key
attention_variant: tri-hybrid: 13 gated short-convolution layers, 5 sliding-window attention layers (sliding_window 256), 6 full-attention layers, per config.json layer_types
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28 from the HF trending feed (rank 14, 6,311 downloads, 253 likes at crawl). Third LFM generation and the first to mix three layer types: 13 conv, 5 sliding, 6 full out of 24, per config.json layer_types - not the 10-conv/6-full split of LFM2/LFM2.5. PARAMS: card states 1.73B; safetensors total is 1,728,801,536 so params_b is 1.7288 and active_params_b equals it (dense). flops_per_token_active = 2 x 1.728801536e9 = 3.4576e9. KV: recorded 0 on the repo's convention for hybrid/SSM stacks (no growing per-token cache), but the nonzero part is: 6 full-attention layers x 2 (K+V) x 4 kv heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes = 12,288 B/token, PLUS 5 sliding-window layers x 2,048 B/token x a 256-token window = 2,621,440 B fixed per sequence. At 262,144 tokens the attention slice is 262,144 x 12,288 = 3.22 GB resident and then flat, versus 24 dense layers at the same geometry = 12,582,912 B/token and 3.3 TB at full context. Dense-check: a 24-layer GQA 16/4 model at head_dim 128 would be 12,582,912 B/token. Card's own comparison is against LFM2.5-2.6B, MiniCPM5-2B, Gemma 4 E4B, Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, i.e. it claims 9B-class agentic behaviour at 1.73B and 1 GB at 4-bit. HARNESS CAVEAT: every row is vendor-run with the harness named per row (OpenClaw for BrowseComp-Plus and WebArena-Verified, OpenCode for the SWE/terminal rows, greedy for BFCL and Claw-Eval), so cross-card comparison with models_run-on a different scaffold is indicative only. Default serving is BF16 at 262,144 tokens. It is NOT recommended by its own card for agentic coding or complex multi-step reasoning.
